meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用测试先行的方式驱动功能开发与缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望在写代码前先通过测试明确预期行为
copy.tagline_en: Write tests first to drive feature development and bug fixes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you like to define expected behavior with tests before writing code

howto.what: 它会按测试驱动开发的顺序工作:先写测试、再写实现,并帮你避开常见的坏测试写法(比如测内部实现、无效的断言)。开始前会先确认要测试的接口边界。
howto.when: 当你提出要按测试优先的方式开发或修 bug,提到“red-green-refactor”,或要求做集成测试时。

say.text: 先用 TDD 给我购物车功能写测试,从红到绿。
say.note: Claude会先确认接口边界,再写失败测试。

say.text: 我要修这个 bug,按红绿循环来,先写失败测试。
say.note: 它会先引导你写出失败测试再实现。

say.text: 这个模块做集成测试,先确认要测的接口边界。
say.note: 它不会在未确认的边界上写测试。

howto.what_en: Follows TDD: writes a failing test first, then minimal code. Avoids bad patterns (internal tests, tautological assertions). Confirms test seams with user first.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to develop or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or requests integration tests.

say_en.text: Use TDD to write tests for the cart feature, red to green.
say_en.note: It will confirm seams, then write a failing test.

say_en.text: I want to fix this bug TDD-style; write the failing test first.
say_en.note: It guides you through red-green implementation.

say_en.text: For this module, define integration test seams before coding.
say_en.note: It won't test at unconfirmed seams.
